title.zh: 卷一百八十七 志第一百四十 兵一
title.raw: 卷一百八十七 志第一百四十 兵一 Volume 187 Treatises 140: Military 1

sentences.zh: 禁軍上

translations.literal: Palace Corps, Part One
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Corps, Part I

sentences.zh: 宋之兵制，大概有三：天子之衛兵，以守京師，備征戍，曰禁軍；

translations.literal: The Song military system, in broad outline, has three kinds: the Son of Heaven's guard troops, to defend the capital and prepare for campaigns and garrison service—called the Palace Corps;
translations.idiomatic: The Song military establishment falls broadly into three categories: imperial guard troops stationed to defend the capital and stand ready for campaign and frontier service—these are the Palace Corps;

sentences.zh: 諸州之鎮兵，以分給役使，曰廂軍；

translations.literal: the garrison troops of the various prefectures, assigned for sundry labor and service—called the Comforter Corps;
translations.idiomatic: prefectural garrison forces detailed for assorted corvée and labor duties—the Comforter Corps;

sentences.zh: 選於戶籍或應募，使之團結訓練，以爲在所防守，則曰鄉兵。

translations.literal: men selected from household registers or through recruitment, organized and trained for local defense—are called the Local Militia.
translations.idiomatic: men drawn from household registers or recruited locally, then organized and drilled for defense in their own districts—the Local Militia.

sentences.zh: 又有蕃兵，其法始于國初，具籍塞下，團結以爲藩籬之兵；

translations.literal: There were also tribal troops; the method began at the founding of the dynasty, registering those below the passes on the frontier and organizing them as barrier forces;
translations.idiomatic: There were also frontier tribal troops. The practice began in the early dynasty: men beyond the passes were registered and organized as a defensive screen along the border;

sentences.zh: 其後分隊伍，給旗幟，繕營堡，備器械，一律以鄉兵之制。

translations.literal: later they were divided into units, given banners and flags, repaired fortresses and stockades, and supplied with weapons—all uniformly under the Local Militia regulations.
translations.idiomatic: later they were formed into units, issued banners and standards, their camps and forts repaired, and arms provided—all governed by the same rules as the Local Militia.

sentences.zh: 今因舊史纂修《兵志》，特置於熙寧保甲之前，而附之鄉兵焉。

translations.literal: Now, in revising the Military Treatises from the old histories, this section is placed specially before the Xining baojia system and attached to the Local Militia.
translations.idiomatic: In compiling the Military Treatises from the earlier histories, we place this material before the Xining-era baojia reforms and group it with the Local Militia.

sentences.zh: 其軍政，則有召募、揀選、廩給、訓練、屯戍、遷補、器甲、馬政八者之目，條分而著之，以見歷朝因革損益之不同，而世道之盛衰亦具是矣。

translations.literal: As for military administration, there are eight categories—recruitment, selection, rations and pay, training, garrison and frontier service, promotion and replacement, arms and armor, and horse administration—each set forth in detail, so that the successive changes and adjustments of each reign may be seen, and the rise and decline of the age are likewise displayed therein.
translations.idiomatic: Military administration is treated under eight headings—recruitment, selection, rations, training, garrison duty, promotion and replacement, arms and armor, and horse administration—each explained in turn, so that one may see how policy shifted from reign to reign and how the fortunes of the age rose and fell with it.

sentences.zh: 嗟乎！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 三代遠矣。

translations.literal: The Three Dynasties are far away.
translations.idiomatic: The age of the Three Dynasties lies impossibly distant.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢而下得寓兵于農之遺意者，惟唐府衛爲近之。

translations.literal: From Qin and Han downward, only the Tang fubing system came near to preserving the old idea of embedding soldiers among farmers.
translations.idiomatic: From Qin and Han onward, only the Tang fubing system came close to preserving the ancient ideal of soldiers living among the farmers who supported them.

sentences.zh: 府衛變而召募，因循姑息，至於藩鎮盛而唐以亡。

translations.literal: When the fubing changed to recruitment, indulgence and laxity followed, until the military commissioners grew powerful and the Tang perished.
translations.idiomatic: When the fubing gave way to hired recruitment, indulgence and drift set in, until the military commissioners grew too strong and the Tang fell.

sentences.zh: 更曆五代，亂亡相踵，未有不由於兵者。

translations.literal: Through the Five Dynasties, turmoil and ruin followed one upon another, and none was without the army as its cause.
translations.idiomatic: Across the Five Dynasties, chaos and collapse followed in unbroken succession—and in every case the army was at the root of it.

sentences.zh: 太祖起戎行，有天下，收四方勁兵，列營京畿，以備宿衛，分番屯戍，以捍邊圉。

translations.literal: Taizu rose from the army, gained the realm, gathered the strong forces of the four quarters, arrayed camps in the capital region for palace guard duty, and rotated detachments for frontier garrison to defend the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu rose from military life to win the realm. He gathered the best troops from every quarter, encamped them around the capital as palace guards, and rotated them in turn to the frontiers to hold the borders.

sentences.zh: 于時將帥之臣入奉朝請，獷暴之民收隸尺籍，雖有桀驁恣肆，而無所施於其間。

translations.literal: At that time, generals and commanders came to court to attend audience; violent and unruly men were enrolled in the registers. Though fierce and insubordinate, they had nowhere to act out their nature.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders then came to court to pay homage; the violent and unruly were enrolled in the rolls. However fierce or defiant they might be, they had no room left to act on it.

sentences.zh: 凡其制，爲什長之法，階級之辨，使之內外相維，上下相制，截然而不可犯者，是雖以矯累朝藩鎮之弊，而其所懲者深矣。

translations.literal: As for the system in general, it established the method of squad leaders, distinctions of rank, mutual binding within and without, and mutual restraint above and below—so sharply defined as to be inviolable. Though this corrected the evils of military commissioners through successive reigns, the lesson it enforced ran very deep.
translations.idiomatic: The system as a whole set squad leaders over every ten men, fixed ranks and grades, and bound men to one another inside and out and up and down—so tightly that no line could be crossed. It was meant to cure the plague of military commissioners, and the warning it carried was a stern one.

sentences.zh: 咸平以後，承平既久，武備漸寬。

translations.literal: After the Xianping era, long peace had prevailed and military readiness gradually slackened.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xianping era, peace had lasted so long that military discipline slowly relaxed.

sentences.zh: 仁宗之世，西兵招刺太多，將驕士惰，徒耗國用，憂世之士屢以爲言，竟莫之改。

translations.literal: In the time of Renzong, too many western troops were recruited by impressment; generals grew arrogant and soldiers lazy, wasting state funds in vain. Men concerned for the age spoke of it again and again, yet nothing was ever changed.
translations.idiomatic: Under Renzong, western recruitment by impressment ran too high; generals grew arrogant and soldiers slack, draining the treasury for little gain. Critics warned of it repeatedly, yet the practice never changed.

sentences.zh: 神宗奮然更制，於是聯比其民以爲保甲，部分諸路以隸將兵，雖不能盡拯其弊，而亦足以作一時之氣。

translations.literal: Shenzong boldly reformed the system: the people were linked in baojia units, and the circuits were apportioned under commanders of generals and troops. Though the abuses could not all be remedied, it was enough to rouse the spirit of the age for a time.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong set out boldly to remake the system: households were linked into baojia, and the circuits reorganized under commanders of generals and troops. The abuses were not wholly cured, but for a time the reform revived the army's morale.

sentences.zh: 時其所任者，王安石也。

translations.literal: The man entrusted at that time was Wang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: The man in charge then was Wang Anshi.

sentences.zh: 元祐、紹聖遵守成憲。

translations.literal: Under Yuanyou and Shaosheng, the established statutes were observed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanyou and Shaosheng reigns, the established rules were kept in force.

sentences.zh: 迨崇甯、大觀間，增額日廣而乏精銳，故無益于靖康之變。

translations.literal: By the Chongning and Daguan periods, quotas grew daily while elite troops grew scarce, so it did no good when the Jingkang crisis came.
translations.idiomatic: By the Chongning and Daguan years, quotas swelled while quality fell, and when the Jingkang disaster struck, the army was of no use.

sentences.zh: 時其所任者，童貫也。

translations.literal: The man entrusted at that time was Tong Guan.
translations.idiomatic: The man in charge then was Tong Guan.

sentences.zh: 建炎南渡，收潰卒，招群盜，以開元帥府。

translations.literal: When the court fled south in the Jianyan era, it gathered routed soldiers, recruited bandit bands, and opened marshal headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jianyan flight south, the court took in routed troops, enlisted bandit bands, and set up marshal headquarters.

sentences.zh: 其初兵不滿萬，用張、韓、劉、岳爲將，而軍聲以振。

translations.literal: At first the army numbered fewer than ten thousand; with Zhang, Han, Liu, and Yue as commanders, its renown was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At first there were fewer than ten thousand men; with Zhang, Han, Liu, and Yue in command, the army's reputation revived.

sentences.zh: 及秦檜主和議，士氣遂沮。

translations.literal: When Qin Hui led the peace negotiations, military morale was crushed.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qin Hui took charge of the peace talks, the army's spirit collapsed.

sentences.zh: 孝宗有志興復而未能。

translations.literal: Xiaozong had the will to recover the lost north but could not achieve it.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong burned to recover the north but never succeeded.

sentences.zh: 光、寧以後，募兵雖衆，土宇日蹙，況上無馭將之術，而將有中制之嫌。

translations.literal: After Guangzong and Ningzong, though recruited troops were many, territory shrank daily; moreover, above there was no art for controlling generals, while below generals feared interference from the center.
translations.idiomatic: After Guangzong and Ningzong, recruitment swelled even as territory shrank; the throne lacked skill in commanding generals, and generals in turn feared meddling from the court.

sentences.zh: 然沿邊諸壘，尚能戮力效忠，相與維持至百五十年而後亡。

translations.literal: Yet the frontier fortresses still strove together in loyalty and held on with one another for a hundred and fifty years before perishing.
translations.idiomatic: Even so, the frontier garrisons fought on in loyalty together and kept the dynasty alive for a hundred and fifty years before the end.

sentences.zh: 雖其祖宗深仁厚澤有以固結人心，而制兵之有道，綜理之周密，於此亦可見矣。

translations.literal: Though the deep benevolence and generous grace of the founding emperors helped bind men's hearts, that there was a proper way to control troops and a thoroughness in overall management may also be seen here.
translations.idiomatic: The founders' deep benevolence surely helped bind hearts to the dynasty—but that they knew how to control armies and administer them with care is plain from this record as well.

sentences.zh: 禁兵者，天子之衛兵也，殿前、侍衛二司總之。

translations.literal: The Palace Corps were the Son of Heaven's guard troops, under the overall command of the two bureaus of the Palace Front and the Palace Interior.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Corps were the emperor's own guard, commanded jointly by the Palace Front and Palace Interior bureaus.

sentences.zh: 其最親近扈從者，號諸班直，其次總於御前忠佐軍頭司、皇城司、騏驥院。

translations.literal: Those closest in attendance and escort were called the various Direct Companies; next below them were units under the Bureau of Loyal Assistants before the Throne, the Imperial City Bureau, and the Fine Steeds Office.
translations.idiomatic: The closest personal escorts were the various Direct Companies; other units fell under the Loyal Assistants before the Throne, the Imperial City Bureau, and the Fine Steeds Office.

sentences.zh: 余皆以守京師、備征伐。

translations.literal: The rest all guarded the capital and prepared for campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: All the rest guarded the capital and stood ready for war.

sentences.zh: 其在外者，非屯駐、屯泊，則就糧軍也。

translations.literal: Those posted outside were either encamped in garrison, stationed in camps, or grain-receiving troops.
translations.idiomatic: Those stationed outside the capital were either in permanent garrison, in temporary camp, or on local grain-pay service.

sentences.zh: 太祖鑒前代之失，萃精銳于京師，雖曰增損舊制，而規模巨集遠矣。

translations.literal: Taizu took warning from the failures of earlier ages and concentrated elite troops in the capital; though the old system was increased or reduced, the design was vast and far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu learned from earlier dynasties' mistakes and massed the best troops in the capital. Later reigns trimmed or expanded the old framework, but the grand design endured.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年，詔遼州降軍宜以效順、懷恩爲名。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiande, an edict ordered that surrendered troops of Liaozhou should take the names Xiaoshun and Huai'en.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 2, an edict named the surrendered troops of Liaozhou the Loyal Submission and Grateful Favor commands.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，詔改西川感化、耀武等軍並爲虎捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, an edict changed the armies of Transformation and Dazzling Martial in western Sichuan, among others, all to Tiger Swift.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 3, an edict renamed the Transformation, Dazzling Martial, and other western Sichuan armies Tiger Swift.

sentences.zh: 九月，上御講武殿閱諸道兵，得萬餘人，以騎兵爲驍雄，步軍爲雄武，並隸侍衛司，且命王繼勳主之，給緡錢俾娶妻。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the emperor reviewed troops from the various circuits at the Hall of Martial Instruction, obtaining more than ten thousand men; cavalry were made Fierce Champions, infantry Bold Warriors, all placed under the Palace Interior Bureau, with Wang Jixun placed in command and silk cash given so they might marry.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor reviewed troops from every circuit at the Hall of Martial Instruction. More than ten thousand were chosen: cavalry became Fierce Champions, infantry Bold Warriors, all under the Palace Interior Bureau. Wang Jixun was put in command and given silk cash so the men could marry.

sentences.zh: 繼勳縱之白日掠人妻女，街使不能禁。

translations.literal: Jixun let them seize men's wives and daughters in broad daylight, and the street commissioners could not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun let his men seize wives and daughters in broad daylight, and the street patrols could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 帝聞大怒，捕斬者百人，小黃門閻承翰見而不奏，亦杖數十。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he was greatly angered; a hundred were seized and executed, and the junior eunuch Yan Chenghan, who had seen it and not reported it, was also beaten several dozen strokes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor flew into a rage, had a hundred seized and executed, and had the junior eunuch Yan Chenghan beaten dozens of strokes for seeing the outrage and failing to report it.

sentences.zh: 開寶七年，泰甯軍節度使李從善部下及江南水軍凡千三十九人，並黥面隸籍，以歸化、歸聖爲額。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kaibao, the troops under Li Congshan, military commissioner of Taining, and the Jiangnan naval forces, 1,039 men in all, were tattooed on the face and entered on the registers under the designations Return to Transformation and Return to Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 7, the 1,039 men under Taining commissioner Li Congshan and the Jiangnan naval force were tattooed and enrolled under the Return to Transformation and Return to Sageliness commands.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，詔改簇御馬直曰簇御龍直，鐵騎曰日騎，龍捷曰龍衛，控鶴曰天武，虎捷曰神衛，骨钅朵子直曰御龍骨朵子直，寬衣控鶴曰寬衣天武，雄威曰雄勇，龍騎曰雄猛。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, an edict changed Clustered Imperial Horse Direct to Clustered Imperial Dragon Direct, Iron Cavalry to Sun Cavalry, Dragon Swift to Dragon Guard, Crane Control to Heavenly Martial, Tiger Swift to Divine Guard, Mace Direct to Imperial Dragon Mace Direct, Loose-Robe Crane Control to Loose-Robe Heavenly Martial, Bold Prestige to Bold Courage, and Dragon Cavalry to Bold Fierce.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 2, an edict renamed Clustered Imperial Horse Direct as Clustered Imperial Dragon Direct, Iron Cavalry as Sun Cavalry, Dragon Swift as Dragon Guard, Crane Control as Heavenly Martial, Tiger Swift as Divine Guard, Mace Direct as Imperial Dragon Mace Direct, Loose-Robe Crane Control as Loose-Robe Heavenly Martial, Bold Prestige as Bold Courage, and Dragon Cavalry as Bold Fierce.

sentences.zh: 八年，改濮州平海指揮爲崇武。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Pinghai command of Puzhou was changed to Reverent Martial.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, the Pinghai command of Puzhou was renamed Reverent Martial.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，改殿前司日騎钅屈直指揮爲捧日钅屈直，日騎改爲捧日，驍猛改爲拱辰，雄勇改爲神勇，上鐵林改爲殿前司虎翼，腰弩改爲神射，侍衛步軍司鐵林改爲侍衛司虎翼。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, the Palace Front Bureau's Sun Cavalry Bent Bow Direct command was changed to Sun-Holding Bent Bow Direct; Sun Cavalry was changed to Sun-Holding; Bold Fierce to Bowing to the Stars; Bold Courage to Divine Courage; Upper Iron Forest to Palace Front Tiger Wing; Waist Crossbow to Divine Archer; and the Palace Interior Infantry Bureau's Iron Forest to Palace Interior Tiger Wing.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4, the Palace Front Sun Cavalry Bent Bow Direct became Sun-Holding Bent Bow Direct; Sun Cavalry became Sun-Holding; Bold Fierce became Bowing to the Stars; Bold Courage became Divine Courage; Upper Iron Forest became Palace Front Tiger Wing; Waist Crossbow became Divine Archer; and the Palace Interior Infantry Iron Forest became Palace Interior Tiger Wing.

sentences.zh: 至道元年，帝閱禁兵有挽強弩至一石五鬥，連二十發而有餘力者，顧謂左右曰：「今宇內阜安，材武間出，弧矢之妙，亦近代罕有也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidao, the emperor reviewed Palace Corps troops and found men who could draw strong crossbows to one stone five dou and shoot twenty shots in succession with strength to spare. He turned to those beside him and said, "Now the realm within the four seas is secure and abundant; martial talent appears here and there, and skill with bow and crossbow is rarely seen in recent ages.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 1, reviewing the Palace Corps, the emperor found men who could draw heavy crossbows to one stone five dou and loose twenty bolts in a row with strength to spare. He turned to his attendants and said, "The realm is at peace, yet martial talent still appears; such mastery of bow and crossbow is rare in our own time.

sentences.zh: 」又令騎步兵各數百，東西列陣，挽強彀弩，視其進退發矢如一，容止中節，因曰：「此殿庭間數百人爾，猶兵威可觀，況堂堂之陣數萬成列者乎！」

translations.literal: " He then ordered several hundred cavalry and infantry each to form ranks east and west, draw strong crossbows, and show advance and retreat with arrows loosed as one, their bearing measured and correct. He said, "These are only several hundred men in the palace hall, yet military majesty is still visible—how much more when tens of thousands stand in grand array!"
translations.idiomatic: " He then had several hundred cavalry and infantry form ranks east and west, draw their crossbows, and advance and retire as one, every movement in measure. He said, "These are only a few hundred men in the palace court, yet their martial bearing is already imposing—what of an army of tens of thousands in full battle order!"

sentences.zh: 咸平三年，詔定州等處本城廳子、無敵、忠銳、定塞指揮，已並升充禁軍馬軍雲翼指揮，依逐州軍就糧，令侍衛馬軍司管轄。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianping, an edict ordered that the commands of Hall Sons, Invincible, Loyal Sharp, and Secure the Frontier at Dingzhou and elsewhere, already promoted together to Palace Corps cavalry Cloud Wing commands, should receive grain according to each prefecture's army and be placed under the Palace Interior Cavalry Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 3, an edict promoted the Hall Sons, Invincible, Loyal Sharp, and Secure the Frontier commands of Dingzhou and other posts to Palace Corps cavalry Cloud Wing commands, paid grain locally in each prefecture, under the Palace Interior Cavalry Bureau.

sentences.zh: 定州揀中廳子第一充雲翼第一，第二充雲翼第二；

translations.literal: At Dingzhou, the first selected Hall Sons unit was made Cloud Wing First, the second Cloud Wing Second;
translations.idiomatic: At Dingzhou, the first selected Hall Sons unit became Cloud Wing First, the second Cloud Wing Second;

sentences.zh: 相州廳子第一充雲翼第三，第二充雲翼第四；

translations.literal: at Xiangzhou, Hall Sons First became Cloud Wing Third, Second Cloud Wing Fourth;
translations.idiomatic: at Xiangzhou, Hall Sons First became Cloud Wing Third and Second Cloud Wing Fourth;

sentences.zh: 保州無敵第一充雲翼第五，第二充雲翼第六，忠銳充雲翼第七；

translations.literal: at Baozhou, Invincible First became Cloud Wing Fifth, Second Cloud Wing Sixth, and Loyal Sharp Cloud Wing Seventh;
translations.idiomatic: at Baozhou, Invincible First became Cloud Wing Fifth, Second Cloud Wing Sixth, and Loyal Sharp Cloud Wing Seventh;

sentences.zh: 威勇軍無敵第一充雲翼第八，第二充雲翼第九，忠銳充雲翼第十；

translations.literal: at Weiyong, Invincible First became Cloud Wing Eighth, Second Cloud Wing Ninth, and Loyal Sharp Cloud Wing Tenth;
translations.idiomatic: at Weiyong, Invincible First became Cloud Wing Eighth, Second Cloud Wing Ninth, and Loyal Sharp Cloud Wing Tenth;

sentences.zh: 靜戎軍無敵充雲翼第十一；

translations.literal: at Jingrong, Invincible became Cloud Wing Eleventh;
translations.idiomatic: at Jingrong, Invincible became Cloud Wing Eleventh;

sentences.zh: 甯邊軍無敵充雲翼第十二；

translations.literal: at Ningbian, Invincible became Cloud Wing Twelfth;
translations.idiomatic: at Ningbian, Invincible became Cloud Wing Twelfth;

sentences.zh: 北平塞無敵充雲翼第十三；

translations.literal: at Beiping Stockade, Invincible became Cloud Wing Thirteenth;
translations.idiomatic: at Beiping Stockade, Invincible became Cloud Wing Thirteenth;

sentences.zh: 深州無敵充雲翼第十四。

translations.literal: at Shenzhou, Invincible became Cloud Wing Fourteenth.
translations.idiomatic: at Shenzhou, Invincible became Cloud Wing Fourteenth.

sentences.zh: 北面諸處應管本城、定塞指揮已下鎮定州、高陽關路都總管，並充禁軍馬軍雲翼指揮，才候升立訖，分析逐指揮員兵士人數、就糧州府、本指揮見在去處以聞。

translations.literal: All commands of local garrison and Secure the Frontier and below on the northern frontier under the overall command of Dingzhou and Gaoyang Pass routes were likewise made Palace Corps cavalry Cloud Wing commands; as soon as promotion was complete, a breakdown of the men in each command, the prefecture for grain pay, and each command's present location was to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: All local garrison and Secure the Frontier commands and below on the northern frontier under the Dingzhou and Gaoyang Pass routes were likewise promoted to Palace Corps cavalry Cloud Wing commands; once promotion was complete, each command's strength, grain-pay prefecture, and present station were to be reported.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔陝西沿邊州軍兵士先選中者，並升爲禁軍，名保捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict ordered that soldiers along the Shaanxi frontier who had been selected first should all be promoted to Palace Corps under the name Secure Swift.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, an edict promoted all previously selected frontier troops in Shaanxi to Palace Corps under the name Secure Swift.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，置廣捷兵士五指揮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, five Broad Swift commands were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 5, five Broad Swift commands were established.

sentences.zh: 五月，命使臣分往邠、寧、環、慶、涇、原、儀、渭、隴、鄜、延等州，於保安、保毅軍內，與逐處官吏選取有力者共二萬人，各於本州置營，升爲禁軍，號曰振武指揮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, envoys were sent separately to Bin, Ning, Huan, Qing, Jing, Yuan, Yi, Wei, Long, Fu, and Yan prefectures to select, together with local officials, 20,000 strong men from the Secure Peace and Secure Resolution armies, establish camps in each prefecture, and promote them to Palace Corps under the name Quake Martial commands.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, envoys were dispatched to Bin, Ning, Huan, Qing, Jing, Yuan, Yi, Wei, Long, Fu, and Yan to work with local officials in selecting 20,000 able men from the Secure Peace and Secure Resolution forces, camp them in each prefecture, and promote them to Palace Corps as Quake Martial commands.

sentences.zh: 既而帝曰：「邊防闕兵，朝廷須爲制置，蓋不得已也。

translations.literal: The emperor then said, "The frontier lacks troops; the court must make arrangements—this is unavoidable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then said, "The frontier lacks troops, and the court must provide for it—there is no choice.

sentences.zh: 候邊鄙乂寧，即可銷弭。

translations.literal: When the borderlands are peaceful and secure, they may then be dissolved."
translations.idiomatic: When the border is calm again, they can be disbanded."

sentences.zh: 」六月，以河東州兵爲神銳二十四指揮、神虎十指揮，又升石州廳子軍爲禁軍，又以威虎十指揮隸虎翼。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month, Hedong prefectural troops were made twenty-four Divine Sharp commands and ten Divine Tiger commands; the Hall Sons army of Shizhou was also promoted to Palace Corps, and ten Bold Tiger commands were placed under Tiger Wing.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month, Hedong prefectural troops became twenty-four Divine Sharp and ten Divine Tiger commands; the Shizhou Hall Sons army was promoted to Palace Corps, and ten Bold Tiger commands were attached to Tiger Wing.

sentences.zh: 景德四年，詔河東廣銳、神銳、神虎軍以見存爲定額，缺則補之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingde, an edict ordered that the Hedong Broad Sharp, Divine Sharp, and Divine Tiger armies take their present numbers as fixed quotas, vacancies to be filled.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 4, an edict fixed the present strength of the Hedong Broad Sharp, Divine Sharp, and Divine Tiger armies as permanent quotas, with vacancies filled as they arose.

sentences.zh: 康定初，趙元昊反，西邊用兵，詔募神捷兵，易名萬勝，爲營二十。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kangding, Zhao Yuanhao rebelled and the western frontier saw military action; an edict recruited Divine Swift troops, changed their name to Myriad Victor, and formed twenty camps.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kangding era, Zhao Yuanhao rebelled and war opened on the western frontier. An edict recruited Divine Swift troops, renamed them Myriad Victor, and formed twenty camps.

sentences.zh: 所募多市井選忄耎，不足以備戰守。

translations.literal: Most of those recruited were weak men chosen from the marketplace, insufficient for battle and defense.
translations.idiomatic: Most recruits were timid men picked from the marketplace, unfit for real fighting or garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 是時禁兵多戍陝西，並邊土兵雖不及等，然驍勇善戰。

translations.literal: At that time most Palace Corps garrisoned Shaanxi; though frontier local troops were not their equal in status, they were fierce and skilled in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Most Palace Corps then garrisoned Shaanxi. Frontier local troops ranked below them, yet they fought with greater dash and skill.

sentences.zh: 京師所遣戍者，雖稱魁頭，大率不能辛苦，而摧鋒陷陣非其所長。

translations.literal: Those sent from the capital for garrison, though called the elite, for the most part could not endure hardship, and breaking the enemy line was not their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Capital troops sent west were called the elite, but most could not endure hardship and were poor at leading charges.

sentences.zh: 又北兵戍及川峽、荊湘、嶺嶠間，多不便習水土，故議者欲益募土兵爲就糧。

translations.literal: Moreover, northern troops garrisoned in Sichuan gorges, Jing and Xiang, and the southern ranges often could not adjust to climate and water; therefore critics wished to recruit more local troops on grain-pay service.
translations.idiomatic: Northern troops posted to Sichuan, the Jing-Xiang region, and the far south often sickened in alien climates, so reformers urged recruiting more local grain-pay militia.

sentences.zh: 於是增置陝西蕃落、保捷、定功，河北雲翼、有馬勁勇，陝西、河北振武，河北、京東武衛，陝西、京西壯勇，延州青澗，登州澄海弩手，京畿近郡亦增募龍騎、廣勇、廣捷、虎翼、步鬥、步武，復升河北招收、無敵、廳子馬，陝西制勝，并州克戎、騎射，麟州飛騎，府州威遠，秦州建威，慶州有馬安塞，保州威邊，安肅軍忠銳，嵐、府州建安，登州平海，皆爲禁兵，增內外馬步凡數百營。

translations.literal: Thereupon were added in Shaanxi the Tribal Frontier, Secure Swift, and Secure Merit commands; in Hebei, Cloud Wing and Strong Steed with Horses; Quake Martial in Shaanxi and Hebei; Martial Guard in Hebei and eastern capital region; Bold Courage in Shaanxi and western capital region; Qingjian of Yanzhou; Dengzhou Clear Sea crossbowmen; in the capital region and nearby prefectures Dragon Cavalry, Broad Courage, Broad Swift, Tiger Wing, Infantry Combat, and Infantry Martial were also increased; Hebei Reception, Invincible, and Hall Sons cavalry, Shaanxi Overcome Foe, Bingzhou Subdue Barbarians and Mounted Archers, Linzhou Flying Cavalry, Fuzhou Awesome Distance, Qinzhou Establish Prestige, Qingzhou Mounted Secure Frontier, Baozhou Awesome Border, Ansu Army Loyal Sharp, Jian'an of Lan and Fu prefectures, and Pinghai of Dengzhou were all promoted to Palace Corps, adding several hundred horse and foot camps within and without.
translations.idiomatic: New Palace Corps units followed across the realm: Tribal Frontier, Secure Swift, and Secure Merit in Shaanxi; Cloud Wing and Strong Steed with Horses in Hebei; Quake Martial in Shaanxi and Hebei; Martial Guard in Hebei and the eastern capital region; Bold Courage in Shaanxi and the western capital region; Qingjian at Yanzhou; Clear Sea crossbowmen at Dengzhou; and in the capital region Dragon Cavalry, Broad Courage, Broad Swift, Tiger Wing, Infantry Combat, and Infantry Martial. Hebei Reception, Invincible, and Hall Sons cavalry, Shaanxi Overcome Foe, Bingzhou Subdue Barbarians and Mounted Archers, Linzhou Flying Cavalry, Fuzhou Awesome Distance, Qinzhou Establish Prestige, Qingzhou Mounted Secure Frontier, Baozhou Awesome Border, Ansu Loyal Sharp, Lan-Fu Jian'an, and Dengzhou Pinghai were all promoted as well—adding several hundred horse and foot camps in all.

sentences.zh: 又京東西、河北、河東、江、淮、荊湖、兩浙、福建路各募宣毅，大州二營，小州一營，凡二百八十八。

translations.literal: In the eastern and western capital circuits, Hebei, Hedong, Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, the two Zhe circuits, and Fujian circuit, Loyal Display troops were recruited in each—two camps in large prefectures, one in small—288 in all.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal Display units were also recruited in the eastern and western capital regions, Hebei, Hedong, Jiang-Huai, Jing-Hu, the two Zhe circuits, and Fujian—two camps in large prefectures, one in small—for 288 camps in all.

sentences.zh: 岢嵐軍別置床子弩炮手。

translations.literal: At Kelan Army a separate corps of bed-frame crossbow and cannon crews was established.
translations.idiomatic: At Kelan Army a separate corps of bed-frame crossbow and artillery crews was added.

sentences.zh: 時吏以所募多寡爲賞罰格，諸軍子弟悉聽隸籍，禁軍闕額多選本城補填，故慶曆中外禁、廂軍總一百二十五萬，視國初爲最多。

translations.literal: At that time officials used the number recruited as the standard for rewards and punishments; sons of soldiers in all armies were allowed to enter the registers; Palace Corps vacancies were mostly filled from local garrisons—thus in the Qingli era Palace and Comforter Corps totaled 1.25 million, the highest since the founding.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were judged by how many men they recruited; soldiers' sons were enrolled freely; Palace Corps gaps were filled from local garrisons. By the Qingli era Palace and Comforter Corps together numbered 1.25 million—the peak since the founding.

sentences.zh: 西師既罷，上患兵冗，帑庾不能給，乃詔省兵數萬人。

translations.literal: When the western campaign ended, the emperor worried over redundant troops and that the treasury could not supply them, and ordered a reduction of tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: When the western war ended, the emperor worried that the army had grown too large for the treasury to sustain and ordered tens of thousands cut.

sentences.zh: 皇祐二年，川峽增置寧遠。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangyou, Secure Distance was added in the Sichuan gorges.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou 2, the Secure Distance command was added in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五年，江、淮、荊湖置教閱忠節，州一營，大州五百人，小州三百人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, in Jiang-Huai and Jing-Hu, Loyal Integrity units for drill and review were established—one camp per prefecture, 500 men in large prefectures and 300 in small.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, Jiang-Huai and Jing-Hu gained Loyal Integrity drill units—one camp per prefecture, 500 men in large prefectures and 300 in small.

sentences.zh: 於是宣毅浸廢不復補，而荊湖、廣南益募雄略。

translations.literal: Thereupon Loyal Display gradually fell into disuse and was no longer replenished, while Jing-Hu and Guangnan increasingly recruited Bold Strategy troops.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal Display units were then allowed to lapse without replacement, while Jing-Hu and Guangnan recruited more Bold Strategy troops.

sentences.zh: 至和二年，廣、桂、邕州置有馬雄略。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhihe, Mounted Bold Strategy was established in Guang, Gui, and Yong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhihe 2, Mounted Bold Strategy units were established in Guang, Gui, and Yong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 明年，並萬勝爲十營。

translations.literal: The next year, Myriad Victor was consolidated into ten camps.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Myriad Victor was consolidated into ten camps.

sentences.zh: 其後，議者謂東南雖無事，不宜馳備。

translations.literal: Later, critics said that though the southeast had no troubles, preparedness should not be neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Later critics argued that even though the southeast was at peace, defenses there should not be neglected.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐四年，乃詔荊南、江寧府、揚、廬、洪、潭、福、越州募就糧軍，號威果，各營於本州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiayou, an edict ordered grain-pay troops recruited at Jingnan, Jiangning prefecture, Yang, Lu, Hong, Tan, Fu, and Yue prefectures under the name Awesome Fruit, each camped in its own prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiayou 4, an edict recruited grain-pay troops at Jingnan, Jiangning, Yang, Lu, Hong, Tan, Fu, and Yue under the name Awesome Fruit, each camped in its home prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又益遣禁軍駐泊，長吏兼本路兵馬鈐轄，選武臣爲都監，專主訓練。

translations.literal: More Palace Corps were also sent for temporary stationing; chief officials concurrently served as circuit military commissioners, and martial officials were chosen as chief supervisors to oversee training.
translations.idiomatic: More Palace Corps were posted in temporary garrison; prefects doubled as circuit military commissioners, and martial officials were chosen as chief supervisors devoted to training.

sentences.zh: 於是東南稍有備矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon the southeast had some defense at last.
translations.idiomatic: The southeast was at last somewhat prepared.

sentences.zh: 七年，宰相韓琦言：

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Chief Councilor Han Qi said:
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Chief Councilor Han Qi memorialized:

sentences.zh: 祖宗以兵定天下，凡有征戍則募置，事已則並，故兵日精而用不廣。

translations.literal: The founding emperors settled the realm by force of arms; whenever there was campaign or garrison duty they recruited and established troops, and when the affair ended they were merged—thus the army grew daily more refined while expenditure did not expand.
translations.idiomatic: The founders won the realm by force of arms. Whenever campaign or garrison duty arose, they recruited troops; when the task ended, those units were merged back—so the army grew sharper while costs stayed contained.

sentences.zh: 今二邊雖號通好，而西北屯邊之兵，常若待敵之至，故竭天下之力而不能給。

translations.literal: Now, though the two frontiers are said to be at peace, the troops garrisoned on the northwest border stand as if always awaiting the enemy's arrival, so the strength of the realm is exhausted and still cannot supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Today both frontiers are said to be at peace, yet northwestern garrisons stand as if the enemy might strike at any moment—and the empire exhausts itself and still cannot pay for them.

sentences.zh: 不於此時先慮而豫備之，一旦邊陲用兵，水旱相繼，卒起而圖之，不可及矣。

translations.literal: If we do not plan ahead and prepare at this time, then once the frontier sees war and flood and drought follow in succession, to devise remedies in sudden haste will be too late.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not plan and prepare now, then when war breaks on the frontier and flood and drought follow in turn, any sudden remedy will come too late.

sentences.zh: 又三路就糧之兵雖勇勁服習，然邊儲貴踴，常苦難贍。

translations.literal: Moreover, though grain-pay troops on the three routes are brave, strong, and accustomed to service, frontier stores are costly and soaring, and support is constantly difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Grain-pay troops on the three frontier routes are brave and well trained, yet frontier supplies are costly and hard to sustain.

sentences.zh: 若其數過多，復有尾大不掉之患。

translations.literal: If their numbers grow too great, there is again the trouble of a tail too large to wag.
translations.idiomatic: If their numbers grow too large, we risk the old problem of a tail too heavy for the body to command.

sentences.zh: 京師之兵雖雜且少精，然漕于東南，廣而易供設，其數多，得強幹弱枝之勢。

translations.literal: Capital troops, though mixed and with few elites, are supplied by transport from the southeast—broad and easy to provision—and are numerous, giving the advantage of a strong trunk and weak branches.
translations.idiomatic: Capital troops, though mixed and not all elite, are fed by grain transport from the southeast—ample and easy to supply—and their numbers give the court a strong trunk and weak branches.

sentences.zh: 祖宗時，就糧之兵不甚多，邊陲有事，則以京師兵益之，其慮深而其費鮮。

translations.literal: In the founders' time, grain-pay troops were not very numerous; when the frontier had trouble, capital troops were added—their foresight was deep and their expense slight.
translations.idiomatic: Under the founders, grain-pay troops were few; when the frontier needed help, capital troops were sent to reinforce them—far-sighted policy at modest cost.

sentences.zh: 願詔樞密院同三司量河北、陝西、河東及三司榷貨務歲入金帛之數，約可贍京師及三路兵馬幾何，然後以可贍之數立爲定額。

translations.literal: I beg that the Bureau of Military Affairs together with the State Finance Commission calculate the annual intake of gold and silk from Hebei, Shaanxi, Hedong, and the Monopoly Goods Offices, estimate how much can support the capital and the three routes' forces, and then set a fixed quota based on what can be supported.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Bureau of Military Affairs and the State Finance Commission calculate annual revenue in gold and silk from Hebei, Shaanxi, Hedong, and the Monopoly Goods Offices, estimate how much can sustain the capital and the three frontier routes, and then fix troop strength to what revenue can bear.

sentences.zh: 額外罷募，闕即增補。

translations.literal: Beyond the quota, cease recruitment; when there are vacancies, fill them.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the quota, stop recruiting; fill vacancies only as they occur.

sentences.zh: 額外數已盡而營畸零，則省並之。

translations.literal: When numbers beyond the quota are exhausted and camps are scattered and odd, then reduce and merge them.
translations.idiomatic: When the excess is gone but undersized camps remain, merge and abolish them.

sentences.zh: 既見定額，則可以定其路馬步軍一營，以若干爲額。

translations.literal: Once the fixed quota is seen, then for each route's horse and foot army one camp may be fixed with a set number as quota.
translations.idiomatic: Once the quota is fixed, each route's horse and foot camps can be set at a standard strength.

sentences.zh: 仍請核見開寶、至道、天禧、慶曆中外兵馬之數。

translations.literal: I further ask that the numbers of troops within and without in the Kaibao, Zhidao, Tianxi, and Qingli eras be verified.
translations.idiomatic: I also ask that troop strength under Kaibao, Zhidao, Tianxi, and Qingli be verified.

sentences.zh: 蓋開寶、至道之兵，太祖、太宗以之定天下、服四方也。

translations.literal: For the armies of Kaibao and Zhidao were those with which Taizu and Taizong settled the realm and subdued the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaibao and Zhidao armies were those with which Taizu and Taizong won the realm and subdued the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 天禧之兵，真宗所以守成備豫也。

translations.literal: The Tianxi armies were those with which Zhenzong preserved the achievement and made preparation.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianxi armies were those Zhenzong kept to guard the achievement and stay prepared.

sentences.zh: 慶曆之兵，西師後增置之數也。

translations.literal: The Qingli armies were the numbers added after the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingli armies were the forces added after the western war.

sentences.zh: 以祖宗之兵，視今數之多少，則精冗易判，裁制無疑矣。

translations.literal: Comparing the founders' armies with present numbers, whether elite or redundant is easily judged, and reduction may be made without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Compare the founders' armies with today's numbers, and it will be easy to see whether we are lean or bloated—and to cut without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 於是詔中書、樞密院同議。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs to deliberate together.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs to deliberate together.

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏：開寶之籍總三十七萬八千，而禁軍馬步十九萬三千；

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: The Kaibao registry totaled 378,000, of which Palace Corps horse and foot were 193,000;
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs reported: under Kaibao, registers totaled 378,000 men, including 193,000 Palace Corps cavalry and infantry;

sentences.zh: 至道之籍總六十六萬六千，而禁軍馬步三十五萬八千；

translations.literal: The Zhidao registry totaled 666,000, of which Palace Corps horse and foot were 358,000;
translations.idiomatic: under Zhidao, 666,000 in all, of whom 358,000 were Palace Corps cavalry and infantry;

sentences.zh: 天禧之籍總九十一萬二千，而禁軍馬步四十三萬二千；

translations.literal: The Tianxi registry totaled 912,000, of which Palace Corps horse and foot were 432,000;
translations.idiomatic: under Tianxi, 912,000 in all, of whom 432,000 were Palace Corps cavalry and infantry;

sentences.zh: 慶曆之籍總一百二十五萬九千，而禁軍馬步八十二萬六千。

translations.literal: The Qingli registry totaled 1,259,000, of which Palace Corps horse and foot were 826,000.
translations.idiomatic: under Qingli, 1,259,000 in all, of whom 826,000 were Palace Corps cavalry and infantry.

sentences.zh: 視前所募後浸多，自是稍加裁制，以爲定額。

translations.literal: Compared with earlier recruitment, numbers afterward gradually increased; from this point slight reductions were made to establish a fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Recruitment had gradually swelled beyond earlier levels; from this point the court trimmed slightly and fixed a permanent quota.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月，樞密使文彥博等上在京、開封府界及京東等路禁軍數，帝亦參以治平中兵數而討論焉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year, Military Affairs Commissioner Wen Yanbo and others submitted the numbers of Palace Corps in the capital, the Kaifeng metropolitan jurisdiction, and routes such as Jingdong; the emperor also consulted troop numbers from the Zhiping era in deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year, Military Affairs Commissioner Wen Yanbo and others submitted Palace Corps strength in the capital, the Kaifeng metropolitan jurisdiction, and routes such as Jingdong; the emperor also weighed these against Zhiping-era troop figures in discussion.

sentences.zh: 遂詔：殿前虎翼除水軍一指揮外，存六十指揮，各以五百人爲率，總三萬四百人；

translations.literal: An edict followed: of the Palace Front Tiger Wing commands, aside from one naval command, retain sixty commands, each at a rate of five hundred men, totaling 30,400;
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: of Palace Front Tiger Wing, aside from one naval command, sixty commands were retained, each at five hundred men, 30,400 in all;

sentences.zh: 在京增廣勇五指揮，共二千人；

translations.literal: In the capital, add five Broad Courage commands, two thousand men in all;
translations.idiomatic: in the capital five Broad Courage commands were added, two thousand men in all;

sentences.zh: 開封府界定六萬二千人，京東五萬一千二百人，兩浙四千人，江東五千二百人，江西六千八百人，湖南八千三百人，湖北萬二千人，福建四千五百人，廣南東、西千二百人，川峽三路四千四百人爲額。

translations.literal: Fixed quotas: Kaifeng metropolitan jurisdiction 62,000, Jingdong 51,200, Two Zhe 4,000, Jiangdong 5,200, Jiangxi 6,800, Hunan 8,300, Hubei 12,000, Fujian 4,500, Guangnan East and West 1,200, the three Sichuan routes 4,400.
translations.idiomatic: quotas were set at 62,000 for the Kaifeng metropolitan jurisdiction, 51,200 for Jingdong, 4,000 for Two Zhe, 5,200 for Jiangdong, 6,800 for Jiangxi, 8,300 for Hunan, 12,000 for Hubei, 4,500 for Fujian, 1,200 for Guangnan East and West, and 4,400 for the three Sichuan routes.

sentences.zh: 在京其餘指揮並河東、陝西、京西、淮南路既皆撥並，唯河北人數尚多，乃詔禁軍以七萬爲額。

translations.literal: In the capital the remaining commands, together with Hedong, Shaanxi, Jingxi, and Huainan routes, had all been reassigned and merged; only Hebei still had excessive numbers, so an edict fixed Palace Corps at seventy thousand as quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital, remaining commands and those of Hedong, Shaanxi, Jingxi, and Huainan had already been reassigned and merged; only Hebei still exceeded the norm, so an edict fixed Palace Corps there at seventy thousand.

sentences.zh: 初，河北兵籍比諸路爲多，其緣邊者且仰給三司，至是而撥並畸零，立爲定額焉。

translations.literal: Initially, Hebei's military registers exceeded other routes; those on the frontier moreover depended on the State Finance Commission for supply—by this point scattered units were reassigned and merged, and a fixed quota established.
translations.idiomatic: At first Hebei's registers outnumbered every other route; frontier units moreover depended on the State Finance Commission for supplies. Now scattered detachments were reassigned and merged, and a fixed quota was set.

sentences.zh: 是時，京東增置武衛軍，分隸河北四路，後又以三千人戍揚、杭州、江寧府，其後又團結軍士置將分領，則謂之將兵雲。

translations.literal: At this time Jingdong added Martial Guard armies, distributed among Hebei's four routes; later three thousand men garrisoned Yangzhou, Hangzhou, and Jiangning Prefecture; afterward soldiers were organized under generals for separate command—they were called "commander troops."
translations.idiomatic: At this time Jingdong raised Martial Guard armies and distributed them among Hebei's four routes; later three thousand men garrisoned Yangzhou, Hangzhou, and Jiangning Prefecture; still later soldiers were grouped under generals in separate commands—these were called commander troops.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，詔頒諸班直禁軍名額：

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, an edict promulgated the titles and quotas of the various squad-direct Palace Corps:
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, an edict promulgated the names and quotas of the various squad-direct Palace Corps:
